Explain Java exception hierarchy and how to handle exceptions.

Java Exception Hierarchy

Java has a well-defined exception hierarchy. Here's the structure:

Exception Handling Example

public class ExceptionExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            readFile("data.txt");
        } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
            System.err.println("File not found: " + e.getMessage());
        } catch (IOException e) {
            System.err.println("IO error: " + e.getMessage());
        } finally {
            System.out.println("Cleanup code");
        }
    }
    
    private static void readFile(String filename) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(filename));
        String line = reader.readLine();
        System.out.println(line);
        reader.close();
    }
}

Show me a flowchart for error handling.

Error Handling Flowchart

flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Is error possible?}
    B -- Yes --> C[Try block]
    B -- No --> D[Continue execution]
    C --> E{Exception occurs?}
    E -- Yes --> F[Catch block]
    E -- No --> G[Finally block]
    F --> G
    G --> H[End]

Exception Types Table

Exception Type Description Checked
NullPointerException Null reference access No
IndexOutOfBoundsException Array index out of range No
FileNotFoundException File not found Yes
IOException I/O operation failure Yes

What about mathematical operations in Java?

Mathematical Operations

Java supports various mathematical operations through the Math class:

Common Math Functions

  • Math.sqrt(x) - Square root
  • Math.pow(x, y) - Power function
  • Math.abs(x) - Absolute value
  • Math.round(x) - Round to nearest integer

Mathematical Equations

The quadratic formula is:

$$x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$$

And the Pythagorean theorem:

$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

Example Code

public class MathExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        double a = 3;
        double b = 4;
        double c = Math.sqrt(a * a + b * b);
        System.out.println("Hypotenuse: " + c);
        
        // Quadratic formula
        double discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c;
        double x1 = (-b + Math.sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * a);
        double x2 = (-b - Math.sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * a);
    }
}
